title: Content Identifiers (CIDs)
key_points: CIDs are unique identifiers for content stored on IPFS.
They are not file hashes but rather a more complex representation.
CIDs have versions, which can change over time.
CID Inspector and CID conversion tools are available.
limitations: The scope is limited to explaining the concepts of CIDs within the IPFS ecosystem.
asserts: Content Identifiers (CIDs) provide a unique address for content stored on IPFS, allowing it to be found and shared.
scope: Explains how Content Identifiers (CIDs) work within the IPFS network and its architecture.
